steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A complaint needs a receipt date, a due date with its rule, and a response before the due date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Response dated after the due date
findings.fix: Record the breach and the response date

findings.title: No receipt date
findings.fix: Record the date the complaint was received

findings.title: Due date with no rule stated
findings.fix: State the rule the due date comes from

outcome.notChecked: Whether the complaint is upheld; any legal duty beyond the stated rule.

pros: Checks a complaint with no receipt date, a response due date with no rule stated, and a response date after the due date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the complaint is upheld; any legal duty beyond the stated rule.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-complaint-handling skill on the records for this review.
